note: UI Styles Library exposes a read-only styleguide page at /admin/appearance/ui/styles (route ui_styles_library.overview, StylesLibraryController::overview) gated by the module permission access_ui_styles_library. It renders getGroupedDefinitions() via theme hook ui_styles_overview_page (ui-styles-overview-page.html.twig) with stylesheet-generator-backed previews. It stores no config, so medium/hard cases are grounded in the module's observable effect: enabling it registers the styles library route and permission. (Role-based grounding was avoided because this shared site's group module config makes Role::save() throw.)

evals.prompt: After enabling UI Styles Library, at what URL do I find the styles library page, and what permission controls access to it?
evals.expected_output: The page is at /admin/appearance/ui/styles (route ui_styles_library.overview) and is gated by the permission access_ui_styles_library.

evals.prompt: What does the UI Styles Library page display and where does it get the list from?
evals.expected_output: It lists every declared UI Styles style and its options with live previews, acting as a styleguide. The controller pulls the list from the style plugin manager via getGroupedDefinitions() and renders it with the ui_styles_overview_page theme hook, using the generated stylesheet for previews.

evals.prompt: Does UI Styles Library store any configuration of its own, and where does its menu link appear?
evals.expected_output: It stores no configuration; it is a read-only page. Its menu link appears under Appearance > UI libraries (ui_suite.index at /admin/appearance/ui) as the 'Styles' link.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is the UI Styles styles library page available? Inspect the live routing and give the route name, its path, and the permission that gates it.
evals.expected_output: Yes: route ui_styles_library.overview at path /admin/appearance/ui/styles, gated by the permission access_ui_styles_library. Confirm with drush ev to look up the route, or drush role:list for the permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the UI Styles styles library page (at /admin/appearance/ui/styles) available by enabling the correct module. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the ui_styles_library module (drush en ui_styles_library -y). Afterwards the route ui_styles_library.overview (path /admin/appearance/ui/styles) is registered and the access_ui_styles_library permission exists.
